function: no_learning: relay precoders come from gradient descent on a convex problem (p. 4); the trained network is the image-classification application served by the link (p. 2).
notes: Exclusion no_learning (Step 1, item 3). The physical-layer design is classical optimization. p. 1: "the precoding matrix for each hop is obtained by the corresponding relay terminal by solving an optimization problem". p. 4: "It is easy to show that the optimization problem is convex, and can be solved via gradient descent". The only learned element is PrototypeNet, an image classifier trained offline on Fashion MNIST. p. 2: "We consider an image classification problem over a multihop MIMO network". It is not federated learning. p. 1: "we adopt offline centralized training to obtain the neural network weights". No learned precoder, detector or estimator appears. If the reviewer treats PrototypeNet as a learned part of the link, the code would be function instead, because over-the-air inference is none of the seven areas. The channel is i.i.d. CN(0,1) (p. 2) and the results are quantitative (p. 4-5).
